about: Per-file mutation floors (percent), checked by scripts/ci/mutation-file-floor.mjs against Stryker's report.
A ratchet: a pull request may raise a floor or add a file, never lower or drop one (the workflow compares this file with the base branch's copy).
Set 2026-11-12 at the scores of the first stable local run (two runs, identical), rounded down, so the same run passes. Raise a floor when tests kill its survivors; never lower it.
Every file here must be a mutate target in stryker.conf.mjs and the other way round (tests/unit/ci/mutation-gate.test.ts).
